Bearer.description: JWT access token. Send it as: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

get.description: The order alerts, newest first. status (Open or Resolved; a name, never a number) defaults to Open. pageSize up to 100. Each item carries the order number and who raised the alert.
One alert, in the same shape as the list items. 404 alert_not_found. This is the Location of POST /admin/orders/{id}/alerts (a plain Admin who raised the alert cannot open it: 403).

patch.description: Closes an Open alert: body { resolutionNote } is required (at most 1000 characters). 200 with the alert. Resolving again answers 422 alert_already_resolved (two parallel resolves give exactly one 200). 404 alert_not_found.

get.description: The audit log, read only, newest first. Filters: userId, entity (the audited type name, for example Order), action (Create, Update, Delete, StatusChange; a name), from and to (UTC instants), page and pageSize (up to 100). The range is at most 92 days (no dates = the last 92 days). The list never carries OldValues or NewValues.
Every non-deleted banner, in order, filtered by placement. Each has a state: Active, Scheduled, Expired or Hidden.

post.description: multipart/form-data: image (required), title, linkUrl (an internal path or an allowed https address, else 400 banner_link_invalid), placement (home), startsAt, endsAt, isActive. 201 with Location; 422 banner_dates_invalid when the end is not after the start.

put.description: Body { placement, bannerIds } with EVERY non-deleted banner of the placement exactly once, in the wanted order; 204. Otherwise 422 banner_reorder_invalid and nothing changes.

delete.description: 204. A soft delete: the banner disappears from the public list and the admin list; the image file is removed after the commit. 404 banner_not_found.

get.description: 404 banner_not_found. The Location of a created banner points here.

put.description: multipart/form-data with the fields of the create; image optional. A replaced image file is removed after the commit. 404 banner_not_found.

post.description: Adds or removes copies through the stock ledger. type is Purchase, Adjustment or Return; quantityDelta is signed, never 0, at most 1000000 in size, and only Adjustment may be negative; reason is required (500 characters after trimming). 201 returns the movement THIS call wrote (its own id, type, quantity, stockAfter, reason, createdAt, createdBy). 400 is the validation shape (errors.quantityDelta, errors.reason, errors.type). 409 stock_insufficient when the stock would go below zero, 409 stock_limit_exceeded when it would pass 2147483647, 404 for a missing or deleted book.

get.description: Filter by status (All, Active, Inactive, Expired) and q (part of the title). Newest first.

post.description: multipart/form-data: title, description, pricingType (FixedPrice or PercentOff), fixedPrice or discountPercent, startsAt, endsAt, isActive, items (JSON text) and an optional image file.

delete.description: A soft delete. Carts and orders that hold the bundle keep working; the bundle is unavailable.

patch.description: Switches the bundle on or off. Switching it off hides it from the public list at once.

get.description: Filter by status (All, Active, Inactive, Expired) and q (part of the code).

post.description: maxUsesPerUser is optional (the store setting Coupon.MaxUsesPerUserDefault when missing). startsAt and endsAt are a date (2026-01-15) or a date with a time. An endsAt date alone means the end of that day in Cairo; a startsAt date alone means its start.

Location.description: The URL of what was created (or of the collection, when it has no GET by id).

delete.description: A soft delete: the uses and the orders keep their history and the usages list still works. A coupon used at the same moment can answer 409 coupon_concurrency_conflict.

get.description: The coupon with its statistics and the rowVersion (base64) for the next update.

put.description: A full replace. rowVersion (base64) is the one the details route returned. Every use of the coupon changes its rowVersion, so a coupon that is being used answers 409 coupon_concurrency_conflict: reload it and send again. A maxUsesTotal below the uses so far answers 422 coupon_total_below_used.

patch.description: Switches the coupon on or off. If the coupon is used at the same moment the answer can be 409 coupon_concurrency_conflict: send it again.

get.description: Who used the coupon, in which order and for how much, newest first. Page size 1 to 100.
The orders placed in the range grouped by status; every status of the lifecycle is listed, zeros included. range defaults to 30d.
Orders and realized revenue per Cairo day (range 7d, 30d, 90d) or per month (12m), every bucket present. range defaults to 30d.
The numbers of today and of this month (Cairo time) and what waits for the owner. Figures can be up to 60 seconds old (server cache).
The best selling books of the range (Delivered orders), with copies and revenue. limit defaults to 5, at most 10; range defaults to 30d.
Filter by isActive (published or hidden), when (upcoming or past) and q (part of the title). Newest start first, at most 100 per page.

post.description: multipart/form-data: title, description (HTML, sanitized on save), location, startsAt, endsAt, isActive and an optional image file. 201 with Location; 422 events_dates_invalid when the end is not after the start; 409 events_slug_taken.

delete.description: 204. A hard delete (the table has no IsDeleted column); the image file is removed after the commit. 404 events_not_found.

get.description: A hidden event too. 404 events_not_found.

put.description: multipart/form-data with the fields of the create plus removeImage. The slug never changes. A replaced image file is removed after the commit.

get.description: Every non-deleted manuscript type in order, active or not.

post.description: Body { name, isActive? }. The type goes last. 201 with Location.

put.description: Body { typeIds } with EVERY non-deleted manuscript type exactly once, in the wanted order; 204. Otherwise 422 manuscript_type_reorder_invalid and nothing changes.

delete.description: 204. A soft delete. 409 manuscript_types_in_use while package requests use the type.

get.description: One manuscript type. 404 manuscript_type_not_found.

put.description: Same body as the create. There is no rowVersion: the last write wins.

get.description: The email log, newest first. Filters: status (Queued, Sent, Failed; a name, never a number), from and to (UTC instants), page and pageSize (up to 100). Each item: type, status, attempts, dates, the address partly masked (a***@gmail.com), a short technical error and canRetry.

post.description: Sends a Failed email again: the row goes to Queued with one conditional update and the same email, rebuilt from the stored template data, goes to the normal send queue. 202 without a body. A row that is not Failed (also a second parallel retry) is 422 notification_already_sent; a Failed row with no stored data (a link email) is 422 notification_not_retryable; 404 notification_not_found; 409 notification_queue_busy when the queue is full.

get.description: Newest first. Filters (all combined with AND): status, paymentMethod (names, never numbers), from and to (UTC days, from must not be after to, at most 366 days), zoneId, and q (at most 100 characters: an order number prefix, or part of the recipient name or phone; wildcards are literal). pageSize up to 100. Every response is no-store.

One order for the back office: totals, recipient snapshot, items (a bundle is one line with its components), ALL payments (rejected ones with their reason), shipment, timeline, internal notes and allowedActions (only what the caller's permissions allow). 404 order_not_found. No-store.

post.description: Raises an alert on an order for the owners. Body { type, message }: type is a name (PaymentMismatch, SuspiciousOrder, CustomerIssue, Other), message is required (at most 1000 characters). 201 with the alert; the owners get an email (order number, type and dashboard link, never the message) after the commit. 404 order_not_found. Location is GET /admin/alerts/{id}.

Cancels an order up to Confirmed (the customer cancel window does not apply) and gives the stock and the coupon use back in one transaction. Body { reason } is required (at most 500 characters). From Preparing or later, or when already cancelled, 422 order_not_cancellable. An approved payment is NOT refunded: the order gets a manual-refund note, requiresManualRefund is true and the owners get an email after the commit.

Confirms a cash on delivery order: PendingPayment to Confirmed. Body { rowVersion }. A manual transfer order is confirmed only by approving its payment, so it answers 422 order_not_cash_on_delivery. Any other status answers 422 invalid_state_transition, a stale rowVersion 409 order_concurrency_conflict.

Shipped to Delivered. Body { rowVersion }. A cash on delivery payment becomes Approved in the same transaction (the amount is the order total). 422 invalid_state_transition from any other status, 409 order_concurrency_conflict for a stale rowVersion. The customer gets an email after the commit.

get.description: The printable invoice of any order (a full HTML page, A4, RTL, with an inline SVG QR). Only Confirmed through Delivered: 422 invoice_not_available otherwise. 404 order_not_found. Closed flag Orders.InvoicePrint = 404. No-store.

patch.description: Replaces the internal note of the order. Body { note } is required (at most 1000 characters). No rowVersion is sent. The note never appears in a customer response or email. Every change is audited. 404 order_not_found.

post.description: Confirmed to Preparing. Body { rowVersion }. 422 invalid_state_transition from any other status, 409 order_concurrency_conflict for a stale rowVersion.

Preparing to Shipped together with the shipment, in one transaction. Body { rowVersion, carrierName, trackingNumber, notes? } (carrier and tracking number are required, at most 100 characters each, notes at most 500). 422 invalid_state_transition from any other status, 409 order_concurrency_conflict for a stale rowVersion. The customer gets an email with the tracking number after the commit.

put.description: Changes the carrier, tracking number and note of the order's shipment while the order is Shipped. Body { carrierName, trackingNumber, notes? }. Once the order is delivered (or in any other status) it answers 422 order_shipment_not_editable.

get.description: The printable shipping label (a full HTML page, A6, RTL, with an inline SVG QR): recipient, phone, address, the big order number, the amount to collect (the total for cash on delivery, zero for a paid transfer) and the carrier and tracking number once shipped. Only Confirmed through Delivered: 422 shipping_label_not_available otherwise. 404 order_not_found. No-store.
Newest first, paged (at most 100 per page). Filters: status, packageId, from and to (UTC days, at most 366 days apart, else 400), q (part of the author name or the work title, or the request number).
Every field of a request with the owner's notes and hasFile (never the storage id). 404 package_request_not_found.

A signed link to the manuscript that lasts 5 minutes: { url, expiresAt }. 404 package_request_not_found, or package_request_file_not_found when no file is stored. The link is never logged, stored or cached; the response is no-store.

patch.description: Body { notes } replaces the owner's note (plain text, at most 1000 characters, the column length); an empty text clears it; 204. The note is never visible to the customer.

Body { status }; 204. Allowed: New to Contacted or Rejected, Contacted to Accepted or Rejected, Accepted to Completed. Anything else, or a request another owner moved first, is 422 package_request_invalid_transition. Every move is audited and the customer gets a status email after the commit.

get.description: Every non-deleted section by its order, with the number of packages in it.

post.description: Body { name, durationMonths, displayOrder?, isActive? }. 201 with Location. durationMonths must be above zero (400). Without displayOrder the section goes last.

delete.description: 204. A soft delete. 409 package_sections_has_packages while a non-deleted package still belongs to it.

get.description: One section. 404 package_section_not_found.

put.description: Same body as the create. There is no rowVersion: the last write wins. A change of durationMonths is written to the audit log with the old and the new value.

get.description: Paged (at most 100 per page) by section order then package order. Filters: sectionId, isActive, q (part of the title). Deleted packages are never listed.

post.description: Body { sectionId, title, intro, badgeText?, price?, priceNote?, durationText, authorBoxTitle, authorBoxText, ctaText, isActive? }. price is null or zero and above (400). The section must exist and not be deleted (422 package_section_unavailable). The package goes last in its section. 201 with Location.

put.description: Body { sectionId, packageIds } with EVERY non-deleted package of the section exactly once, in the wanted order; 204. Otherwise 422 package_reorder_invalid and nothing changes.

delete.description: 204. A soft delete: package requests keep their own snapshot and stay readable.

get.description: One package with its items (type, then order). 404 package_not_found.

put.description: Same body as the create. There is no rowVersion: the last write wins. A new sectionId moves the package last in that section. A change of the price or of durationText is written to the audit log with the old and new value.

post.description: A hidden copy with the same items, titled with the suffix (نسخة), last in the same section, made in one transaction. 201 with Location.
Body { type (Feature, Condition or Step), title, description? }. The item goes last among the items of its type. 201; the Location is the package, which carries its items.

put.description: Body { type, itemIds } with EVERY item of that type exactly once, in the wanted order; 204. Otherwise 422 package_item_reorder_invalid and nothing changes.
Same body as the add. A new type puts the item last among the items of that type. 404 package_item_not_found.

patch.description: Body { isActive }; 204. Hiding a package removes it from the public page at once.

get.description: The payment review queue, oldest submission first. status (Pending, Submitted, Approved, Rejected; a name, never a number) defaults to Submitted. pageSize up to 100. The amount is the order total.

post.description: Approves a Submitted payment and confirms its order in one transaction (empty body). 422 payment_not_submitted for a payment that is not waiting for review (also a second approve), 404 payment_not_found, 409 order_concurrency_conflict. The customer gets an email after the commit.

get.description: A short-lived signed link to the proof screenshot of a payment: { url, expiresAt }. 404 payment_not_found when the payment does not exist or has no stored proof. The link is never logged, stored or cached; the response is no-store.

The printable receipt of an Approved payment of any order (a full HTML page, RTL, with an inline SVG QR). 422 payment_receipt_not_available while the payment is not Approved. 404 payment_not_found. Closed flag Orders.InvoicePrint = 404. No-store.

post.description: Rejects a Submitted payment: body { reason } is required (at most 500 characters). The order goes back to PendingPayment with the same ExpiresAt, the rejected payment stays as history and the customer may upload a new proof. 422 payment_not_submitted, 404 payment_not_found. The customer gets an email with the reason after the commit.

get.description: Filter by isActive. Newest first, at most 100 per page.

post.description: Body { text (at most 1000, plain text), bookId?, authorId?, isActive, displayDate? }. 201 with Location. 422 quote_reference_not_found for a book or author that does not exist.

delete.description: 204. A hard delete (the table has no IsDeleted column). 404 quote_not_found.

get.description: 404 quote_not_found. The Location of a created quote points here.

put.description: Replaces the quote with the same body as the create. There is no rowVersion (last write wins). 404 quote_not_found, 422 quote_reference_not_found.

get.description: Per coupon used by orders placed in the period: usages, total discount and the orders total. Returned usages and Cancelled orders are excluded. From and to are required Cairo dates (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive), at most 366 days. format is json (default), csv or html; csv and html need the Reports.Export flag and are written to the audit log.

The stock now, per book (hidden included, deleted excluded): stock, active reservations, available, the low stock threshold, isLow and the stock moved in and out in the last 30 Cairo days. format is json (default), csv or html; csv and html need the Reports.Export flag and are written to the audit log.

Orders placed in the period (Cairo days) grouped by status (default), zone or paymentMethod, with the count and the total amount; zones without orders are left out. From and to are required Cairo dates (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive), at most 366 days. format is json (default), csv or html; csv and html need the Reports.Export flag and are written to the audit log.

Publishing requests created in the period: counts by status and one line per request (reference, Cairo time, status, customer name, package). No file link and no contact data. From and to are required Cairo dates (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive), at most 366 days. format is json (default), csv or html; csv and html need the Reports.Export flag and are written to the audit log.

Sales of Delivered orders by delivery day (Cairo time), grouped by day, month, book or category (default day). Net revenue is what customers paid; a book sold inside a bundle counts its units but has 0 revenue (the bundle price is on the bundle line). A book in several categories is a row in each, so the totals come from the orders, not from the rows. From and to are required Cairo dates (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive), at most 366 days. format is json (default), csv or html; csv and html need the Reports.Export flag and are written to the audit log.
Newest first. Filter by status (Active, Fulfilled, Expired, Cancelled), bookId and userId. pageSize up to 100.

post.description: Reserves quantity copies of a book for the registered customer with this email, for the number of days of the store setting Reservation.DurationDays. The reservation lowers the available quantity until it is fulfilled, cancelled or expires. 409 stock_insufficient carries availableQuantity. There is no note field: the table has no column for it.

Location.description: The URL of what was created (or of the collection, when it has no GET by id).

post.description: Cancels an Active, unexpired reservation and frees its copies. No stock moves. A reservation that is not active, or whose time has passed, is 422 reservation_not_active.

Turns an Active, unexpired reservation into a sale: the stock is deducted once (a Sale movement). A reservation that is not active, or whose time has passed, is 422 reservation_not_active. If the stock is lower than the quantity the answer is 409 stock_insufficient with availableQuantity and nothing changes.

get.description: Filter by status (Pending, Approved, Rejected) and bookId. Newest first, at most 100 per page.

delete.description: 204. A hard delete (the table has no IsDeleted column); the audit log keeps it.

post.description: 204. The review becomes public and counts in the book rating. 422 review_not_pending for a review that was already approved or rejected.
204. The body is { reason: optional, at most 500 characters } (send {} for none); the reason is not stored. 422 review_not_pending for a review that was already decided.

get.description: The changes of the permissions of a role (grants and revokes), read only, newest first. Each item says when, who, the role, the permission key and whether it was granted or revoked. page and pageSize (up to 100).

post.description: Body { name, email, phone? }. Creates an Admin account with a confirmed email and no usable password, and queues the existing password-reset email so the owner of the account sets one. 201 with Location and the user details; 409 users_email_taken; 400 for a bad name, email or phone.

get.description: Filter by status (All, Active, Unsubscribed) and q (part of the address). Newest first, at most 100 per page. The address is whole: the list is for the owner.

A CSV file (UTF-8 with a byte order mark, subscribers-YYYY-MM-DD.csv) of the subscribers, streamed row by row. A cell that starts with = + - or @ gets a leading apostrophe. The export is written to the audit log (who, when, the number of rows; no address). Filters: status and q.

Newest account first, paged (at most 100 per page). Filters: q (part of the name, the email or the phone; a phone is also tried in its 01xxxxxxxxx form; % and _ are literal), role (Customer, Admin, SuperAdmin or Developer) and isActive. Each item has id, name, email, phone, role, isActive, emailConfirmed and createdAt (null: the user table has no registration date). No password hash, security stamp or token is ever returned.

The list fields plus lastLoginAt and an orders summary: count (every order, cancelled ones included), total (the sum of the totals of the orders that are not cancelled) and recent (the last 5 orders, newest first, with id, number, status, total and createdAt). 404 users_not_found.

put.description: Body { role } (Customer, Admin, SuperAdmin or Developer, else 400); 204. Nobody changes their own role; nobody changes a user whose role is above theirs; a SuperAdmin grants Customer or Admin only; a Developer grants any role; an Admin grants nothing (all 403 users_role_change_forbidden). The same role is a 204 that changes nothing. A change revokes the user's refresh tokens, changes the security stamp, clears the permission cache of both roles and is audited with the role before and after. An access token already issued keeps its old role for up to 5 minutes. 409 users_concurrency_conflict when someone changed the user at the same moment.

patch.description: Body { isActive }; 204. Disabling revokes every refresh token of the user at once and changes the security stamp; the user cannot log in or refresh any more (the same 401 as a wrong password). An access token already issued stays valid until it expires (5 minutes). 403 users_cannot_disable for yourself, a Developer account, a SuperAdmin account (unless the caller is a Developer) or a user above your role. Both directions are audited. 404 users_not_found.

post.description: Signed-in. A wrong current password is 400 auth_current_password_invalid. Every other session ends and the caller gets a fresh refresh cookie. Access tokens already issued stay valid until they expire (5 minutes).
Anonymous, like confirm-email: the link in the email carries userId, the new address and the token. The email changes only here. A bad, expired or reused token is 400 auth_invalid_token.
Signed-in. Revokes every refresh token of the caller and clears the cookie. Access tokens already issued stay valid until they expire (5 minutes).

get.description: The banners shown now in the placement (default home), in order: imageUrl, alt (the title or a neutral default) and linkUrl. Cached for 5 minutes. An unknown placement is 400.
Published books ranked by the copies sold in the last 90 days (Delivered orders only), ties newest first. limit defaults to 12, at most 24. No sales numbers; an empty list when nothing sold.

post.description: 201 with the review in Pending state (it is public only after a moderator approves it). 404 review_book_not_found for a book that is missing or unpublished. 409 review_already_exists for a second review of the same book.

get.description: The approved reviews of a published book, newest first: a short display name, the rating, the comment and the date. 404 review_book_not_found for an unknown book.
The active bundles inside their dates whose books are all published. Each bundle carries its books, the price, the saving against buying the books one by one, and a stock status.
404 bundle_not_found for a bundle that is hidden, outside its dates, deleted or holds an unavailable book.

post.description: Returns 201 with the whole cart when a new line was created. When the quantity was merged into an existing line the status is 200 with the same body. A 409 stock_insufficient problem carries availableQuantity.

Location.description: The URL of what was created (or of the collection, when it has no GET by id).

post.description: Read only: prices the current cart for an address or a shipping zone and an optional coupon. Nothing is reserved, used or stored. Send exactly one of addressId and zoneId. zone.shippingFee is the base price of the zone; the top-level shippingFee is the fee actually charged (0 when free shipping applies). Like POST /orders it answers 422 cart_empty for an empty cart, 409 cart_has_unavailable_items for an unavailable line and 422 order_line_price_invalid for a line whose unit price is 0 (a price of 0 or a 100 percent discount).

get.description: Published events. when=upcoming (default, nearest first) or past (most recent first); an unknown value is 400. Paging up to 48.
The event with its full description (sanitized). 404 events_not_found for an event that is hidden, deleted or unknown.
The active manuscript types in order, for the manuscript form.

put.description: Signed-in. Changes the name, the phone and the language and answers the same body as GET /me. The email is not changed here (see POST /me/email).

Location.description: The URL of what was created (or of the collection, when it has no GET by id).

post.description: Signed-in. A wrong current password is 400 auth_current_password_invalid. The answer is 202 with an empty body whatever the new address is (free, taken by another user, or the current one), so it never reveals whether an address is registered. The email changes only after the link sent to the new address is confirmed.

Body { email }. 202 with the same body for every well formed address (new, already subscribed, or subscribed before and gone), so the route reveals nothing. A malformed address is 400. 5 requests per hour per IP, then 429.
Body { token } (the token of the link in the email). 204 for every token of a good shape, known or not; a token of a wrong shape is 400. Uses the general rate limit.

get.description: The caller's own orders, newest first. status is an OrderStatus name in PascalCase (an unknown value is 400). pageSize is 1 to 48 (default 20). The page has items, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages, hasPreviousPage and hasNextPage. itemsCount counts a bundle once.

post.description: Places the order from the current cart. The Idempotency-Key header is required (400 idempotency_key_required). Sending the same key and the same body again returns the same 201 response with the same Location and the header Idempotency-Replayed: true and creates no second order; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_mismatch. Only a 201 is stored: a failed attempt does not lock the key, so it can be retried after the cart is fixed. Two simultaneous requests with the same key wait for each other and one order is made; a duplicate that waits too long (20 seconds) gets 409 idempotency_in_progress with Retry-After: 1. Location is /api/v1/orders/{id}. The body never carries a price, a total or a shipping fee; paymentMethod is ManualTransfer or CashOnDelivery. 409 stock_insufficient lists the books with availableQuantity, and 409 cart_has_unavailable_items lists the items.

parameters.description: 8 to 100 characters of letters, digits, hyphen or underscore. Scoped per user.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Location.description: The URL of what was created (or of the collection, when it has no GET by id).

get.description: One order of the caller. An order that does not exist and an order of another user both answer 404 order_not_found. An id that is not a guid does not match the route (404 without a body).

put.description: Edits the shipping details of the caller's order before preparation (PendingPayment, PaymentReview or Confirmed; later = 422 order_not_editable). rowVersion (base64) is required and must be the one the details returned (stale = 409 order_concurrency_conflict). Only the supplied fields change: recipientName, phone, addressFields {city, addressLine, landmark}, zoneId, notes (empty notes or an empty landmark clear the value). A body with no field is 400. A zoneId that differs from the order's zone is allowed only in PendingPayment (otherwise 422 order_zone_change_locked); it recomputes only the shipping fee and the total from the stored subtotal and coupon discount. An edit that changes nothing returns 200 with the unchanged order and the same rowVersion.

post.description: Cancels the caller's order and gives the stock and the coupon use back in one transaction. reason is optional (at most 500 characters). Allowed up to the store setting Order.LastCancelableStatus (never later than Confirmed for a customer); otherwise, or when the order is already cancelled, 422 order_not_cancellable. A concurrent change of the order gives 409 order_concurrency_conflict and nothing is kept. An approved payment stays as it is (refund is manual).

get.description: The printable invoice (a full HTML page, A4, RTL, with an inline SVG QR) of the caller's order. Only Confirmed through Delivered: 422 invoice_not_available before that or when cancelled. An order that does not exist and an order of another user both answer 404 order_not_found. Closed flag Orders.InvoicePrint = 404. No-store.

post.description: Uploads the transfer screenshot of the caller's ManualTransfer order (multipart/form-data: screenshot = JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 5 MB, transactionReference optional (at most 100), senderPhone optional (Egyptian mobile)). The amount is never accepted: it is the order total. The file is stored privately and the order moves to PaymentReview. 400 payment_proof_file_invalid for a file that is not such an image; 422 payment_proof_not_allowed (not a pending ManualTransfer order), payment_proof_order_expired, payment_proof_already_submitted; 409 payment_reference_taken for a reference used by another payment; 404 order_not_found for a missing or another user's order. Subject to the upload rate limit (429 with Retry-After).

get.description: The printable receipt (a full HTML page, RTL, with an inline SVG QR) of an Approved payment of the caller's order. 422 payment_receipt_not_available while the payment is not Approved. An order that does not exist and an order of another user both answer 404 order_not_found; a payment that is not on that order answers 404 payment_not_found. Closed flag Orders.InvoicePrint = 404. No-store.

The caller's own requests, newest first (page, pageSize up to 48): id, the package as it was when the request was made (title, price, section), workTitle, status and createdAt. Never the owner's notes, the storage id or a file link.

post.description: Sends a manuscript for a publishing package (multipart/form-data: packageId, authorName, phone (Egyptian mobile), workTitle, manuscriptTypeId, synopsis, notes optional, file = PDF or DOCX of at most 25 MB). The contact email is the account's. The file is checked by its content (400 manuscript_file_invalid for anything else, including an old DOC) and stored privately. The package title, price and section are copied into the request. 201 with Location and the request without any file reference; 422 package_not_available or manuscript_type_not_available. The Idempotency-Key header is not supported here (the idempotency filter does not take multipart bodies). Subject to the upload rate limit (429 with Retry-After).

get.description: One of the caller's own requests (the Location of the create). Another user's request is 404 package_request_not_found, never 403.

Every active section with its active packages, ordered by section order then package order. Each package has its price (or priceNote when the price is null), duration text, author box, button text, features and conditions (the item titles) and steps (title and description). Cached for an hour.
One package in the same shape as the list: its section with a packages array of that one package. A hidden or deleted package, or one in a hidden section, is 404 package_not_found.

Only the payment methods POST /orders would accept right now (the same rule). method is the exact name POST /orders takes: CashOnDelivery or ManualTransfer. ManualTransfer carries details: the non-blank transferNumbers (each { channel: VodafoneCash or InstaPay, number }), instructions (null for now) and expiresInHours. A disabled method is absent; both closed gives an empty array.
The quote of the Cairo day, the same for everybody all day: text, speaker (the linked author) and a link to the book or the author. 204 when no quote is active.
The publicly visible books, authors, categories (by slug) and CMS pages (by key) with their last change in UTC, newest first. No paging: at most 50000 items per type.
The current user's saved books, newest first, as book cards plus addedAt. A deleted or unpublished book is not listed. pageSize defaults to 48 and is at most 48.
The ids of the saved books (at most 500, no paging), so the frontend can paint the hearts on cached public cards. Public book cards carry no wishlist flag.

delete.description: 204 whether the book was saved or not.

put.description: 204 whether the book was added or was already saved. 404 wishlist_book_not_found for a book that is missing, deleted or unpublished. 422 wishlist_limit_reached at 500 books.
